[ISSUE #1] [SEVERITY: Critical] [FRAMEWORK: WCAG] [CRITERION: 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum)] Description: The "MINECRAFT JAVA EDITION" logo text has insufficient contrast against the pink cherry blossom background. The white text on the light pink background results in a contrast ratio of approximately 3.5:1, which is below the 4.5:1 requirement for normal text. Impact: Users with low vision or color blindness may struggle to read the logo text, reducing the interface's accessibility and clarity. Fix: Increase the logo text contrast by changing the text color to a darker shade (e.g., #333333) or adding a dark text shadow (e.g., text-shadow: 1px 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.8)). [ISSUE #2] [SEVERITY: High] [FRAMEWORK: WCAG] [CRITERION: 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast] Description: The green "PLAY" button (background: #4CAF50) against the dark semi-transparent background (rgba(0,0,0,0.7)) has a contrast ratio of approximately 2.8:1, which is below the 3:1 requirement for UI components. Impact: Users with low vision may have difficulty distinguishing the button from its background, reducing the button's visibility and clickability. Fix: Increase the button background color brightness or saturation (e.g., #5CDA5F) to achieve a 3:1 contrast ratio, or add a 1px solid border with sufficient contrast (e.g., border: 1px solid #FFFFFF). [ISSUE #3] [SEVERITY: High] [FRAMEWORK: WCAG] [CRITERION: 2.1.2 No Keyboard Trap] Description: The "Join" button in the LunaSMP server card is not keyboard focusable, and there is no visible focus indicator for any interactive elements in the server card. Users cannot navigate to or activate this button using the keyboard. Impact: Keyboard-only users cannot join the server, creating a significant accessibility barrier. Fix: Add `tabindex="0"` to the "Join" button and ensure it has a visible focus state (e.g., `:focus { outline: 2px solid #FFFFFF; outline-offset: 2px; }`). [ISSUE #4] [SEVERITY: Medium] [FRAMEWORK: WCAG] [CRITERION: 2.4.7 Focus Visible] Description: The "PLAY" button in the main action bar lacks a visible focus indicator. When tabbed to, the button does not show a clear visual cue (e.g., outline or border) indicating it is focused. Impact: Keyboard users may not know which element is currently focused, leading to confusion and potential errors. Fix: Add a visible focus style to the "PLAY" button (e.g., `:focus { outline: 2px solid #FFFFFF; outline-offset: 2px; }`). [ISSUE #5] [SEVERITY: Medium] [FRAMEWORK: WCAG] [CRITERION: 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value] Description: The dropdown menus for "1.20.4 (Offline)" and "Vanilla" do not have accessible names. Screen readers may announce them as "combobox" without context, making it unclear what they control. Impact: Screen reader users cannot understand the purpose of these dropdowns, hindering interaction. Fix: Add `aria-label` attributes to the dropdowns (e.g., ``). [ISSUE #6] [SEVERITY: Medium] [FRAMEWORK: Nielsen] [CRITERION: 1. Visibility of System Status] Description: There is no loading indicator when the launcher is preparing to launch the game. Users may be unsure if the system is processing their "PLAY" action. Impact: Users may become impatient or confused, potentially clicking the button multiple times or thinking the application has frozen. Fix: Add a loading spinner or progress bar above the "PLAY" button when the launch process is initiated (e.g., `
` with `display: none;` by default, shown on click). [ISSUE #7] [SEVERITY: Medium] [FRAMEWORK: Nielsen] [CRITERION: 9. Help Users Recognize, Diagnose, and Recover from Errors] Description: If the launcher fails to launch the game (e.g., due to missing files or outdated Java), there is no clear error message displayed to the user. Impact: Users will not know why the launch failed and will struggle to resolve the issue, leading to frustration. Fix: Implement a modal or toast notification that displays a clear, concise error message (e.g., "Failed to launch Minecraft. Please ensure Java is installed and up to date.") with a link to troubleshooting steps. [ISSUE #8] [SEVERITY: Low] [FRAMEWORK: LawOfUX] [CRITERION: Fitts's Law] Description: The "Join" button in the LunaSMP server card is relatively small (approximately 40px tall) and may be difficult for users with motor impairments to click accurately. Impact: Users may miss the button or click adjacent elements, reducing interaction efficiency. Fix: Increase the button height to at least 48px (e.g., `height: 48px; padding: 12px 24px;`) to improve target size and clickability. [ISSUE #9] [SEVERITY: Low] [FRAMEWORK: LawOfUX] [CRITERION: Hick's Law] Description: The top navigation bar contains five menu items ("PLAY", "MODPACKS", "PROFILE", "SETTINGS", "IDK CONNECT"), which may overwhelm users with too many choices, especially new users. Impact: Users may take longer to decide which option to click, increasing cognitive load. Fix: Consider grouping less frequently used options (e.g., "IDK CONNECT") under a "More" dropdown or removing non-essential items to reduce decision complexity. [ISSUE #10] [SEVERITY: Low] [FRAMEWORK: WCAG] [CRITERION: 1.4.13 Content on Hover or Focus] Description: The "AD" label in the top-right corner of the LunaSMP server card may not be dismissible or may obscure content when hovered/focused, violating the requirement that hover/focus content is dismissable. Impact: Users may find the label intrusive or difficult to interact with if it covers other elements. Fix: Ensure the "AD" label is either always visible without obscuring content or can be dismissed with a click (e.g., `position: absolute; top: 5px; right: 5px;` with a small close button). [VISUAL HIERARCHY & LAYOUT]: PASS — no issues found. [COLOR & CONTRAST]: Issues found (see #1, #2). [INTERACTIVE FEEDBACK]: Issues found (see #3, #4). [FORM DESIGN]: Issues found (see #5). [NAVIGATION]: PASS — no issues found. [LOADING & EMPTY STATES]: Issues found (see #6). [ERROR HANDLING]: Issues found (see #7). [RESPONSIVENESS]: PASS — no issues found (layout appears to reflow at 320px). [ACCESSIBILITY]: Issues found (see #1, #2, #3, #4, #5). [CONSISTENCY]: PASS — no issues found (button styles appear consistent). [PERFORMANCE PERCEPTION]: PASS — no issues found (no visible loading delays). [MINIMALISM]: PASS — no issues found (interface is clean and focused on core actions).
